pgsql_server.description: PostgreSQL connection URL in the form 'postgresql://user:password@host:port/database'

pgsql_database.description: PostgreSQL database name (optional if embedded in `pgsql_server`)

pgsql_port.description: PostgreSQL server port (used if not embedded in `pgsql_server`)

pgsql_connect_timeout.description: Timeout (in seconds) for establishing a connection to PostgreSQL

pgsql_query_getpw.default: SELECT home FROM ftp_users WHERE username = ':username'
pgsql_query_getpw.description: SQL query to fetch the user's home directory (required)

pgsql_query_getuid.default: SELECT uid FROM ftp_users WHERE username = ':username'
pgsql_query_getuid.description: SQL query to fetch the user's numeric UID (required)

pgsql_query_getgid.default: SELECT gid FROM ftp_users WHERE username = ':username'
pgsql_query_getgid.description: SQL query to fetch the user's numeric GID (required)

pgsql_query_getquota.default: SELECT quota_size, quota_files FROM ftp_users WHERE username = ':username'
pgsql_query_getquota.description: SQL query to fetch upload quota (max space in MB and max files). Returns NULL for unlimited.

pgsql_query_checkuser.description: SQL query to verify user existence. Should return at least one row if user exists.

pgsql_query_getbwup.description: Optional SQL query to fetch per-user upload bandwidth limit (in bytes/sec).

pgsql_query_getbwdown.description: Optional SQL query to fetch per-user download bandwidth limit (in bytes/sec).

pgsql_query_getallowedips.description: Optional SQL query to fetch allowed IP ranges (CIDR) per user, comma-separated. If empty, all IPs allowed.

pgsql_query_gettls.description: Optional SQL query to enforce TLS. If query returns non-empty (e.g., 'Y'), user must use FTPS.
